metadata.description: Reserved keywords and control-flow terms from common programming languages. These are always preserved verbatim in the output.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A conditional keyword that executes a block of code only when a condition evaluates to true.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A keyword that executes an alternative block when the preceding if condition is false.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A loop keyword that repeatedly executes a block as long as a condition is true.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A loop keyword that iterates over a sequence or a range.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A keyword that exits the current function and optionally passes a value back to the caller.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A Python keyword used to define a function.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A keyword used to define a class (blueprint for objects) in OOP languages.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A keyword to load external modules or libraries into the current program.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A keyword that wraps a block of code to catch exceptions.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A keyword that handles exceptions raised in the corresponding try block.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A keyword that defines a block that always executes regardless of exceptions.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A keyword used to manually raise an exception.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A keyword that allocates memory and creates a new object.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A keyword that deallocates previously allocated memory.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A keyword that declares a variable as immutable (constant).

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A keyword used to declare an asynchronous function.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A keyword that pauses execution of an async function until a promise resolves.

entries.label: PROG_KEYWORD
entries.definition: A keyword for defining anonymous (unnamed) functions inline.
